content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble with [product_name] [version_no]. When I try to print, the software freezes. Has anyone else experienced this? I'm using Windows 8 64-bit OS. Thank you.
Welcome. Could you provide a screenshot of the issue? Thank you.
The software gets stuck when selecting the printer, and no information is shown. Thank you.
Are you using an extended monitor setup?
Yes, I'm using an extended monitor. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: User is experiencing a freeze when attempting to print from [product_name] [version_no] under Windows 8 64-bit, specifically at the printer selection stage. The use of an extended monitor may be connected to the issue. No error messages appear, resulting in confusion and a lack of resolution for the user.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects smooth and dependable printing from the software, without freezes or interruptions, and clear notifications if any issue arises.
